page.layout: Binding only: a grey cloth cover, photographed with the spine at left. No printed text block on this image.
page.notes: This is the outside cover of the book, not a printed page. The spine has a red label with partly legible printed fragments, roughly "...ONEA", "...PICA", "...ESA" and a numeral, which are too cut off to read reliably and are not transcribed. A worn paper label and a small number are visible near the bottom of the spine. The cover itself is plain, with light foxing and spotting, and no printed words.
